notes: Lesson IDs match beginnerCourse.json URLs; course order and numbering remain in that file.
newItems records vocabulary first encountered in learner-facing explanations, tables, examples, or exercises. Greek titles and grammar labels are excluded.
Each item has a permanent unique ID. Later forms refer to that ID instead of duplicating the word. Meanings describe the uses taught so far.
forms lists forms actually encountered in the introducing lesson, not a complete dictionary paradigm. newForms records additional forms encountered in later lessons.
Expressions are studied as whole units unless their component words are separately listed. flashcard: false marks contextual items that should not become default flashcards.
A lesson with no new words can still introduce new forms. Review vocabulary can be determined from the lesson text; this file does not yet enumerate every repetition.
Maintain this record when editing lessons. It is authoring data for future activities, not a published vocabulary page.
